text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
――Hey, Flash.
Studying for the exams too?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-san. Yes, that is correct.
Though strictly speaking, it would be 'we'.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no way. Numbers are impossible. Just looking at them is impossible.
A '1' is so totally not an upgrade, it kills my vibe.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha! Th-then that means...!
Adding a zero to a one is just exaggerating~!?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, 100 million is mega hype, right!?
Omg, did we just master numbers or what!? Are we geniuses!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...While helping Falcon-san study,
Jordan-san asked me to tutor her as well.
I was just adjusting my schedule."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Sounds like you have your hands full.
Well, I'm in a similar situation myself, but—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaaaah!!
Me no understand English at all!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, idiot.
And stop trying to talk like you speak English, you idiot.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah, you called me an idiot twice!
One plus one equals two, you know!?
What're you gonna do if I get even dumber than this, huh--!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...We both have it rough. Hopefully, we can manage
to avoid failing marks this time as well..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have no concerns on that point.
If I study according to the schedule I just finished,
I will reliably score well above average.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Since we can allocate training time toward studying this time,
that gives us two extra hours. If I wake up earlier every day,
we can adequately prepare.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me for saying this, but are those two really capable of that?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I promised that I wouldn't let you get a failing grade.
If that is so, no matter what happens, I will see it through.
...Farewell for now."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...I see,
so those two were the ones having a hard time."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My "pupil" has been slacking off a bit lately too...
Maybe I should adopt the Flash-kun approach for once?
